name: M. Abdelbasset
bio: This is my engineering lab: a place to build, document, and improve the systems behind reliable application delivery.
about: I learn by building real systems. My current focus is a hands-on OpenShift lab on a Hetzner dedicated server, with three virtual machines running on KVM/libvirt. Here, I document the decisions, experiments, and lessons along the way.

projects.title: OpenShift home lab
projects.description: A three-node OpenShift lab on a Hetzner dedicated server. Built on KVM/libvirt, with installation notes documenting the setup.

projects.title: GitOps application delivery
projects.description: Taking this Flask portfolio from local development to OpenShift. Planned next: automated image builds, reviewed promotions, self-healing, and recovery experiments.
